visualCharacteristics: Horizontal row of service entries, each a heading, short two-line text and a link.
contentPattern: One row per service: optional image cell, then h3 heading, text paragraph and CTA paragraph (<strong> primary, <em> secondary). Can be repeated for multiple rows.
usage: "Weitere Services" section linking to external platforms (App-Shop, Media-Center, UI-Guidelines, training).
reuseGuidance: Use for compact lists of external services or tools; add a second services block for another row.
